_meta.by: tools/build_pin_formats.py from counties/<st>.json + live samples tools/pin_samples.json
_meta.lookup: entry = states[ST].counties[County] if present, else states[ST].default
_meta.format_key: # = digit, A = letter, any other character is literal (space = a space); ' or ' separates formats the county uses side by side
_meta.search: CAD passes the typed text through unchanged; the engine searches searched_field exactly, except search_ignores_spaces counties (spaces dropped on both sides)
_meta.label_rule: Parcel No. when the county's search key is its parcel number (Dare) or the field is a parcel-number field; PIN when the field is a PIN; else PID. The printed PID line itself is a style choice.
_meta.examples: real values served live by each county layer; never invented
